title: Combined tracking area updating procedure accepted by the network

entities.name: Combined tracking area updating procedure accepted by the network
entities.description: Procedure executed when the network accepts a combined tracking area update request from the UE.

entities.name: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT
entities.description: Message sent by the network to accept a tracking area update request.

entities.name: EMM-REGISTERED
entities.description: EMM state where the UE is registered with the network.

entities.name: Tracking area update accepted condition
entities.description: Condition when the network accepts the combined tracking area update request.

relations.description: The procedure includes sending the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message.
The procedure requires the UE to be in EMM-REGISTERED state.
The acceptance condition triggers the combined tracking area updating procedure.
